name: Argent disponible par unité
query:
SELECT
	cc.name AS cost_center,
	cc.cost_center_name AS cost_center_name,
	IFNULL(gl.banque, 0) + IFNULL(gl.realloc, 0) AS banque,
	IFNULL(gl.caisse, 0) AS caisse,
	IFNULL(gl.ar, 0) AS ar,
	IFNULL(gl.passif, 0) AS passif,
	IFNULL(gl.banque, 0) + IFNULL(gl.realloc, 0) + IFNULL(gl.caisse, 0) - IFNULL(gl.passif, 0) AS disponible,
	IFNULL(gl.banque, 0) + IFNULL(gl.realloc, 0) + IFNULL(gl.caisse, 0) - IFNULL(gl.passif, 0) + IFNULL(gl.ar, 0) AS disponible_ar
FROM `tabCost Center` cc
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		gle.cost_center AS cost_center,
		SUM(CASE WHEN acc.account_number = '1011' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS banque,
		SUM(CASE WHEN acc.account_number = '1012' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS caisse,
		SUM(CASE WHEN acc.account_number = '1030' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS realloc,
		SUM(CASE WHEN acc.account_number = '1021' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS ar,
		SUM(CASE WHEN acc.account_number IN ('2010', '100301464RT0001', '1006141893TQ0001') THEN GREATEST(gle.credit - gle.debit, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS passif
	FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
	INNER JOIN `tabAccount` acc ON acc.name = gle.account
	WHERE gle.company = %(company)s
		AND gle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
		AND IFNULL(gle.is_cancelled, 0) = 0
		AND IFNULL(gle.cost_center, '') != ''
		AND acc.account_number IN ('1011', '1012', '1030', '1021', '2010', '100301464RT0001', '1006141893TQ0001')
	GROUP BY gle.cost_center
) gl ON gl.cost_center = cc.name
WHERE cc.company = %(company)s
	AND cc.is_group = 0
	AND cc.disabled = 0
ORDER BY FIELD(cc.cost_center_name, 'Groupe', 'Colonie', 'Louvette', 'Meute', 'Troupe', 'Clan'), cc.cost_center_name
